overview_description.description: Preset is an open analytics data platform, built on Apache Superset™, that makes any team productive with data. With an intuitive visual interface, Preset empowers users to explore and analyze their data. Flexible dashboarding capabilities and a deep set of visualization types make communicating and sharing data-driven insights simple and fast. Lightweight and cloud native, Preset supports the workflows of modern teams.

about_short_description.short_description: Preset is a software-as-a-service company that offers a cloud-based open analytics data platform.

product.name: Preset Cloud
product.description: A cloud-hosted business intelligence platform based on Apache Superset for data visualization and dashboard creation.

product.name: Embedded Dashboards
product.description: A service to integrate and embed interactive analytics dashboards into internal tools or customer applications.

product.name: Managed Private Cloud Solution
product.description: A managed deployment of Preset’s BI platform within a customer’s private cloud environment for enhanced security and compliance.

product.name: Preset AI Assist
product.description: An AI-powered feature that converts natural language prompts into SQL queries to simplify data exploration.

product.name: Preset API
product.description: An API enabling programmatic management of Preset’s Superset instances, including user, workspace, and asset administration.
